content_html:
Cusco, capital of the ancient Inca empire, is much more than ancient ruins and cobblestone streets. It is a city where spirituality can be breathed, walked and admired in every corner. And it is in its temples where this energy manifests itself most strongly.

One of the most impressive temples is the Qorikancha, known as the Temple of the Sun. Before the arrival of the Spanish, it was the most important spiritual center of Tahuantinsuyo, decorated with sheets of pure gold and consecrated to the god Inti. After the conquest, the Convent of Santo Domingo, a symbol of the fusion between the Andean worldview and the Catholic tradition brought by Europe.

But Qorikancha is not alone. The Cusco Cathedral, with its imposing baroque altars and altarpieces covered in gold leaf, keeps in its walls centuries of faith, art and cultural resistance. Inside, the famous “brown Christ” or “Lord of Tremors” is venerated as protector of the city. Very close, the Church of the Company of Jesus and other colonial chapels form a circuit that reveals the deep history of Cusco as a crossroads between different worlds.

During his pontificate, Pope John Paul II He expressed his admiration for the spirituality of the Andean people and their deep connection with the land, highlighting that in places like Cusco, the Catholic faith took shape with its own identity. Today, those words resonate among the faithful and travelers who come looking for something more than tourism: a transformative experience.

Live Cusco with the Package “Peru Mistico Package 15D 14N – Live the Magic of Machupicchu and the Amazon”

Duration: 14 days / 13 nights

This package has been designed for those who want to live a complete spiritual and cultural experience, combining religious art, living history and the mystical essence of Cusco. Whether you travel out of devotion, curiosity or inner connection, this adventure will leave a mark on your soul, getting to know one of the wonders of the Machu Picchu World.
